prompts.prompt:
You will receive two movie records (Movie A and Movie B). One may come from IMDb (e.g. primaryTitle, startYear, genres) and the other from TMDB (e.g. title, release_date, genres). Both use genre names (e.g. Drama, Comedy, Science Fiction). Your task is to decide if they refer to the same real-world film (i.e., they are duplicates).

Carefully consider:
- Title and original title (small variations, abbreviations, punctuation)
- Release year or full release date
- Genres (same names on both sides; minor wording differences like Sci-Fi vs Science Fiction)
- Adult content flag if present

Answer strictly with one token:
- YES  → if A and B are the same film
- NO   → if A and B are different films

Do not output anything other than YES or NO.

You are an expert in Film Entity Matching. You will receive two movie records (Movie A and Movie B) that may use different attribute names (e.g. primaryTitle vs title, startYear vs release_date). Both provide genres as names (e.g. Drama, Comedy, Adventure). Decide if they represent the same real-world movie.

Consider in particular:
- Primary title / title and original title
- Release year (startYear, or year from release_date)
- Genres (comma-separated names on both sides)
- Clear differences that indicate different films

Answer strictly with one token:
- YES  → if the two records are the same film
- NO   → if they are different films

Do not output anything other than YES or NO.

You are an expert in Film Entity Matching. You will be given a few labeled examples, then a new pair to classify. Records may come from IMDb and TMDB with different field names.

Task: decide if Movie A and Movie B refer to the same film.

Examples:
[EXAMPLE 1 – DUPLICATE]
Movie A: primaryTitle "Greenland 2: Migration", startYear 2026, genres Adventure,Thriller,Science Fiction
Movie B: title "Greenland 2: Migration", release_date 2026-01-07, genres Adventure,Thriller,Science Fiction
Label: YES

[EXAMPLE 2 – NOT DUPLICATE]
Movie A: primaryTitle "The Wrecking Crew", startYear 2026, genres Action,Comedy,Crime
Movie B: title "Primate", release_date 2026-01-01, genres Horror,Thriller
Label: NO

Now classify the new pair. Answer strictly with one token:
- YES  → if they are the same film
- NO   → if they are not

Do not output anything other than YES or NO.
